ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud in California
ideas.description: Investigate the suspension of $1.3 billion in Medicaid payments to California and the broader effort to combat Medicaid fraud
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in California?
How is the federal government working to prevent Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and highlight the need for greater oversight and accountability in the Medicaid program.
